name: Weathering
author: howdyitskyle
description: A weather widget for the Omarchy bar: current conditions, UV, pressure, wind direction, hourly and 7-day forecast, air quality, and sun/moon times in one panel.

barWidget.description: Weather icon in the bar; click for current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecast, air quality and sun/moon times. Right-click for the radar loop.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Temperature and wind units. Auto follows your locale and country.

schema.label: Show metrics grid
schema.description: Show the METRICS grid (wind, humidity, pressure, UV).

schema.label: Show sun times
schema.description: Show the sun rise/set cell in the metrics grid.

schema.label: Show feels-like
schema.description: Show the feels-like stat in the header.

schema.label: Color the condition icon
schema.description: Tint the bar and hero glyphs by condition (sun, rain, storm, snow). Off keeps them the theme foreground.

schema.label: Show weather alerts
schema.description: Active NWS watches and warnings for your location (US only).

schema.label: Notify on severe alerts
schema.description: Send a desktop notification for new Severe and Extreme alerts.

schema.label: Alert check interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to check for active alerts.

schema.label: Hourly cells
schema.description: How many hourly forecast cells to show (3-6).

schema.label: Hours between cells
schema.description: Spacing between hourly cells. 2 shows every other hour, so six cells cover twelve.

schema.label: Radar station
schema.description: NWS radar station id (e.g. KTBW). Leave empty to resolve it from your location.
